name: columnValuesToBeInSet
displayName: Column Values To Be In Set
description: Checks column values against an allowed set according to the matchEnum mode.

parameterDefinition.name: allowedValues
parameterDefinition.description: Values used for matching. Neither mode requires every allowed value to occur in the column.

parameterDefinition.name: matchEnum
parameterDefinition.description: If true, every observed value must be allowed. If false or omitted, the test passes when at least one allowed value occurs, even if other values are outside the set.
